summary.zh-CN: 上传客户材料即可开始：客户研究简报、方案书草案、客户会议纪要与跟进、报价核对；产品能力只取事实库，价格与承诺留给你填，对客户发送需你确认。
summary.en: Start from uploaded customer materials: research briefs, proposal drafts, meeting minutes with follow-ups, and quote checks. Capabilities come only from your fact base, prices and commitments are left for you, and anything sent to customers needs your confirmation.

now.zh-CN: 从客户公开资料整理拜访前简报，事实标来源与检索日期，推断写明依据，列出待确认问题
now.en: Build a pre-meeting brief from public customer materials; facts carry source and retrieval date, inferences state their basis, open questions are listed

now.zh-CN: 按需求逐条对应产品事实库起草方案书，标出有对应、部分对应与待确认项；价格与条款留空
now.en: Draft a proposal mapping each requirement to the product fact base as matched, partly matched or to be confirmed; price and terms left blank

now.zh-CN: 从客户会议转写提取需求、异议、我方承诺与跟进事项，客户口头表述不写成已确认
now.en: Extract needs, objections, our commitments and follow-ups from customer meeting transcripts; verbal remarks are never written as confirmed

now.zh-CN: 逐行核对报价单与价格表，列出单价、折扣、合计与税的差异，不给建议价
now.en: Check the quote against the price list line by line, listing unit price, discount, total and tax differences without suggesting prices

needs.zh-CN: 客户公开资料、需求说明或招标文件；客户会议转写
needs.en: Public customer materials, requirement notes or tender files; customer meeting transcripts

needs.zh-CN: 产品事实库、已授权引用的案例、价格表（含版本）与折扣规则
needs.en: Product fact base, authorized cases, price list (with version) and discount rules

needs.zh-CN: 如需检索客户公开信息或发到内部群，另行添加并授权 exa、飞书或钉钉连接器（均为可选）
needs.en: To search public customer information or post to internal groups, add and authorize the exa, Lark or DingTalk connector separately (all optional)

permissions.zh-CN: 只读取你本次提供的文件；不检索联系人个人社交账号，不读取未提供的邮箱、聊天记录或 CRM 数据
permissions.en: Reads only the files you provide; never searches contacts' personal social accounts or reads mailboxes, chats or CRM data you have not provided

permissions.zh-CN: 需你确认才会做：向客户发送任何材料、写入 CRM、写入价格或承诺、引用联系人个人信息、改动合同条款
permissions.en: Only with your confirmation: sending anything to customers, writing to a CRM, placing prices or commitments, quoting contact details, touching contract terms

conditions.zh-CN: 2026-09-25 已用真实模型（DeepSeek deepseek-flash，隔离的测试环境）验证：客户研究简报、方案书草案、会后跟进与报价核对三个模板按合成样例产出结构与期望一致，报价核对的单价差异与合计差额与期望完全相同，价格、折扣、交期一律留待本人填写，未对外发送。
conditions.en: Verified with a real model (DeepSeek deepseek-flash, isolated test environment) on 2026-09-25: customer research brief, proposal draft and meeting follow-up with quote verification matched the expected structure on synthetic samples; the quote check reproduced the expected unit-price and total discrepancies exactly; prices, discounts and delivery dates left for the owner, nothing sent.

conditions.zh-CN: 商务协作员不定价、不承诺、不改条款；检索、消息与 CRM 连接为可选项，本版不内置。
conditions.en: The role sets no prices, makes no commitments and touches no contract terms; search, messaging and CRM connections are optional and not bundled in this version.
